title: DAP patterns registry
description: Index of reusable DAP patterns. Single catalogue consumed by the Figma plugin (list/search/insert) and by code tooling. The registry is generated/validated in CI; the pattern trees under patterns/<id>/ are the source of truth.

tokens.description: Where the token sources live. Patterns reference tokens by path only; values are never stored in a pattern.

source.description: Path/URL of the W3C-style token.json (Tokens Studio / Figma export, sets = collection/mode).

figmaKeys.description: Path/URL of figma-keys.json (variable, style and component publish keys).

dsVersion.description: Version of the DS the patterns were validated against, e.g. dapDS 0.56.x.

categories.description: Optional ordered category list for the plugin UI. Items must use one of these ids when present.

title.description: Human title shown in the plugin list (HU).

description.description: One or two sentences: what it is and when to use it.

category.description: e.g. forms, navigation, feedback, content, layout, page.

version.description: semver of the pattern tree. Breaking = atoms/props replaced, non-breaking = spacing/copy.

pattern.description: Path to the pattern tree (pattern.schema.json), relative to the registry, e.g. patterns/callout-with-action/pattern.json.

src.description: PNG/WebP preview for the plugin card.

uses.description: DS components the tree instantiates (figma-keys.json component names). Derived from the tree in CI and checked for equality; kept here so the plugin can search/filter without loading every tree.

code.description: Code counterpart of the same pattern (shadcn-style registry item), if one exists.

registryItem.description: Path/URL of the code registry item, e.g. dap-screen-kit registry id or a source file.

screenKit.description: dap-screen-kit registry key, if this pattern maps to a ScreenRenderer block.

figma.description: Optional Figma-native source (library component) for the library-key insert mode. Not needed for tree-based insert.

modes.description: Variable modes the preview/tree was authored in (informational; the tree's own `modes` is what the plugin applies).

treeHash.description: FNV-1a hash of the pattern tree (stable key order, `$schema` ignored). Generated by `npm run validate -- --stamp`. The plugin writes the hash of the tree it inserted next to the frame, so it can tell that a frame came from an older tree.
